AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: abyssal signal interpretation
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: A first contact interpreter for Abyssal signal noise. It converts anomaly, rhythm and impossible geometry into a minimal Protocol vocabulary.

reveals.li: Early Forge hint visibility and unknown-pattern framing.

unlocks.li: Marks the first contact layer as understood.
Keeps early Forge hints legible.

notes.li: Auto-decoded once vanilla research prerequisites are met.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: primitive breach protocols
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: A controlled low-tier breach grammar for small invocations, primitive sigils and limited hostile response patterns.

reveals.li: Primitive breach and lesser sigil families.
Early ritual entries in the Summoning/Forge progression map.

unlocks.li: Reveals primitive breach and low-tier sigil families.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: residue recognition
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Identification of Infernal Residue as contact-matter: the first usable industrial shadow cast by an abyssal event.

unlocks.li: Reveals the earliest residue handling vocabulary.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: forge contact vocabulary
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: A translation layer between Abyssal Forge output signatures and readable production categories, including unknown pattern families.

unlocks.li: Allows the Forge to display unknown pattern families instead of hiding them.

notes.li: Auto-decoded. This is the bridge between Nexus and Forge cards.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: circle stabilizer frames
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Structural logic for early stabilizer frames, breach anchors and repeatable circle support modules.

reveals.li: Circle support patterns and placement logic.

unlocks.li: Reveals early stabilizer/module infrastructure.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: ashbound capacitance
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Early capacitor theory for storing ritual pressure as a controlled industrial load instead of a runaway map event.

reveals.li: Energy support diagnostics for circle infrastructure.

unlocks.li: Reveals ashbound capacitor and early energy support patterns.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: residue processing
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Processing methods that turn raw residue into repeatable reagent chains for Forge recipes, modules and ritual materials.

unlocks.li: Reveals early core/resource recipes.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: basic abyssal arms
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Early weapon-pattern translation for blades, pistols, repeaters and other residue-stabilized battlefield forms.

reveals.li: Rift Blade, Hex Pistol, Sigil Repeater and related basic arms families.

unlocks.li: Reveals early weapon cards in the Forge.

notes.li: One project unlocks a family, not one item.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: ashbound combat kit
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Early protective equipment logic for ashbound apparel, combat frames and contact-resistant field kit.

reveals.li: Ashbound kit and Infernal Combat Frame families.

unlocks.li: Reveals early armor/apparel cards.

notes.li: One project unlocks a family, not one item.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: rift ballistics
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Mid-tier weapon doctrine for rift projectiles, shaped fracture paths and armor-disrupting ballistic signatures.

reveals.li: Rift Carbine, Rift Needler and related mid-tier weapon families.

unlocks.li: Reveals rift carbines, needlers and related mid-tier weapons.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: null geometry handling
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Classification of null pressure, anti-aura geometry and absence-driven weapon or field behavior.

reveals.li: Null weapon and null-field pattern families.
Null Marksman / Null Disruptor style cards.

unlocks.li: Reveals null weapon and null-field pattern families.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: basic abyssal implants
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: First internal Protocol procedures for controlled body integration, early organs and low-tier implant families.

reveals.li: Infernal Eye / early body upgrade families.
Basic surgery and Forge-linked implant classification.

unlocks.li: Reveals early implant procedures.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: abyssal armor systems
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Mid-tier armor systems for remaining coherent under breach pressure, null stress and sustained abyssal exposure.

unlocks.li: Reveals mid-tier armor and accessories.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: elite summoning patterns
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Specialized invocation grammar for elite formations, tactical enemies, support nodes and mid-tier encounter families.

reveals.li: Elite encounter and mid-tier sigil families.
Specialized hostile role previews in the Protocol map.

unlocks.li: Reveals elite encounter and mid-tier sigil families.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: core integration
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Integration theory for Abyssal Cores as functional organs of the external system rather than simple power sources.

reveals.li: Mid-tier implant and weapon support chains.

unlocks.li: Reveals core-powered implants and mid-tier production requirements.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: modular turret interface
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Initial turret-module protocol for automated defense slots, targeting states and controlled breach-fire systems.

reveals.li: Targeting Sigil, Cooling Lattice, Residue Capacitor and basic module diagnostics.

unlocks.li: Reveals basic modular turret chassis/modules.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: archon sigil handling
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Boss-grade sigil handling for archon marks, authority events and preserved invocation permissions.

unlocks.li: Reveals archon and boss-gated invocation rights.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: major boss invocation
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Invocation logic for domain-bearing bosses, major ritual escalation and high-pressure encounter control.

reveals.li: Reactor Saint / domain boss summon classification.
Boss-tier ritual gates and risk language.

unlocks.li: Reveals Reactor Saint and major-boss invocation families.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: crown logic decoding
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Decoding of Crown Shards, authority fragments and late Forge rights as a protocol of command rather than rarity.

reveals.li: Dominion and Final Gate prerequisite language.

unlocks.li: Reveals crown-tier Forge logic and late resource recipes.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: heavy infernal systems
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Heavy weapon doctrine for boss damage, siege pressure, anti-fortification systems and late industrial breach arms.

reveals.li: Vesper Lance, Litany Grinder, Phalanx Driver, Gatebreaker Spiker and related systems.

unlocks.li: Reveals heavy infernal and anti-fortification weapons.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: advanced implants
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Late implant procedures for choir resonance, saint-grade organs and crown-compatible biological interfaces.

reveals.li: Late surgery and Forge-linked implant gates.

unlocks.li: Reveals advanced implant procedures.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: gatebreaker carapace logic
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Boss-arena armor doctrine for gatebreaker shells, saint-grade protection and prolonged breach exposure.

reveals.li: Saint Aegis / Vesper Halo / high-tier protective gear classification.

unlocks.li: Reveals Gatebreaker and Saint-resistant armor families.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: breach lockdown systems
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Advanced turret doctrine for breach denial, choir arcs, harpoons, plasma lanes and high-pressure defensive systems.

reveals.li: Plasma Lance, Choir Arc, Harpoon, Vesper/Cinder style lockdown systems.

unlocks.li: Reveals advanced turret module families.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: dominion gate bootstrapping
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Dominion-class synchronization for Great Gate preludes, Hell entry and the first administrative breach layer.

reveals.li: Dominion Sigil and Great Gate prelude logic.
Tier V Dominion Slice access language.

unlocks.li: Reveals Dominion entry preparation and Hell-tier routing.

notes.li: Tier V is Hell/Dominion Slice, not Final Gate.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: dominion slice cartography
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Cartography for Dominion Slice maps, hell terrain, abyssal architecture, fissures and hostile extra-map geography.

reveals.li: Dominion Slice map and site classification.
Hell terrain, fissure, platform and side-architecture families.

unlocks.li: Frames Dominion terrain, pockets, approach vectors and map hazards.

notes.li: Real decode project for Hell UI/lore.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: infernal pocket stabilization
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Pocket-space stability logic for controlled transfer, temporary Hell containment and return conditions.

reveals.li: Hell encounter stability and cleanup diagnostics.

unlocks.li: Reveals pocket runtime, exit handling and Dominion transition support.

notes.li: Real decode project for Hell infrastructure.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: anchor-law breach analysis
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Analysis of Dominion hearts, anchors and authority nodes that bind hostile infrastructure to a battlefield.

reveals.li: Dominion heart and anchor encounter logic.
Dominion boss-map failure and cleanup signals.

unlocks.li: Frames Dominion anchors, heart pressure and collapse mechanics.

notes.li: Real decode project for Hell encounters.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: dominion survival frames
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Survival-frame doctrine for armor and field systems meant for maps that no longer obey ordinary RimWorld space.

reveals.li: Crowned Core armor / hellside protective gear.
Tier V apparel and survival-frame gates.

unlocks.li: Reveals Dominion survival armor and Crowned Core defensive patterns.

notes.li: Real decode project for Hell rewards.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: crowned core extraction
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Extraction logic for Crowned Core fragments, Dominion Crown Shards and high-tier Forge materials recovered from authority nodes.

reveals.li: Crowned Core fragment and Dominion Crown Shard handling.

unlocks.li: Reveals Crowned Core, Dominion Crown Shard and Hell-tier reward processing.

notes.li: Real decode project for Hell rewards.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: dominion biology
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Dominion biological interface theory for hellside implants, crown-compatible organs and body systems shaped by hostile jurisdiction.

unlocks.li: Reveals Dominion implant families.

notes.li: Real decode project for Hell rewards.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: final gate architecture
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Final Gate architecture for encounter-scale infrastructure, layered anchors and the transition beyond Dominion Slice logic.

reveals.li: Tier VI event architecture and anchor families.

unlocks.li: Frames future Final Gate access.

notes.li: Future reserve. Current playable scope mostly ends before this.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: crowned gate invocation
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Invocation grammar for the Crowned Gate as an event-machine rather than a single creature or standard boss.

reveals.li: Gate, anchor and wave integration logic.

unlocks.li: Frames future Crowned Gate encounter access.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: apex weaponry
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Apex weapon doctrine for entities whose visible bodies are only interfaces for deeper authority.

reveals.li: Breach Cannon / Ultra Plasma / final anti-domain weapon classification.

unlocks.li: Frames future apex weapon gates.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: crownfire / sepulcher calibration
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Final-tier turret calibration for crownfire launch systems, sepulcher rails and anti-domain automated weapons.

unlocks.li: Frames final turret systems.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: heraldic fragment analysis
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Heraldic fragment interpretation for messages, addresses and permissions left by higher invasion interfaces.

reveals.li: Specter Lash / Crownspike / Crownshard style schemas.
Tier VII transition into Herald content.

unlocks.li: Frames Herald weapons and fragment interpretation.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: oblivion choir interface
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Interface theory for Oblivion Choir structures, heraldic resonance and late post-Dominion signal pressure.

reveals.li: Oblivion Choir and late Herald interfaces.

unlocks.li: Frames future Herald combat families.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: schism cartography / godshard forensics
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Forensic cartography of schism-signatures, godshard traces and severance-grade contradictions beyond normal Dominion authority.

unlocks.li: Frames future schism, godshard and severance systems.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: interface beyond the gate
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Final forbidden interface theory for the layer beyond gods, gates and readable dominion hierarchies.

reveals.li: The One Behind the God future layer.

unlocks.li: Frames ultimate continuation hook and hidden endgame reserve.
